title: CLCON/342/2006 of KALLU SINGH Vs RATAN KUMAR JAIN AN D ANOTHER

paras.text:
CLCON No. 342/2006
Honíble B.C. Kandpal, ACJ.
 This contempt petition under
Section 12 of Contempt of Courts Act has
been filed by the petitioner for summoning
the opposite parties for willful and
deliberate disobedience of the order dated
24.02.2006 passed in Civil Writ Petition No.
865 (S/S) of 2004, Kallu Singh vs. State of
Uttaranchal & others.
 Heard Sri Pankaj Miglani, learned
counsel for the petitioner, Smt. Bina
Pandey, learned Standing Counsel (U.P.) for
the respondents and perused the record.
 The relevant portion of impugned
judgment reads as follow:
 ìIn view of the aforesaid, the
respondents are directed to decide the
representations dated 17.02.2004 &
21.06.2004 in accordance with law for
providing retirement benefits etc. within a
period of 6 weeks from the date of
production of certified copy of this order.î
 Respondent no. 1 has filed
supplementary affidavit and in paragraphs
2 & 3 of supplementary affidavit it has been
stated that representation of petitioner was
decided on the basis of departmental
inquiry vide order dated 9.3.2007, which
has been annexed as Annexure No. 1 to
the affidavit of compliance.
 Since representation of petitioner
has been considered and decided by the
respondents, I do not find any justification
to continue the contempt petition against
the respondents.
 Accordingly, contempt petition is
dismissed. Notices issued against the
respondents are hereby discharged.
(B.C.K., ACJ)
03.03.2009
SP
